 THE FIVE EXCEPTION CLASSES, EACH WITH ITS OWN k
==========================================================================

--- DEFAULT (whole-design worst, expect k=1) ---
  from  : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_eu:u_eu|upc_opc[3]~DUPLICATE
  to    : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|nec_bus:bus|ad_in_q[8]
  k = 1.0000   slack =   +4.745   ->  T_min  26.505 ns  =    37.73 MHz

--- k=4.0  $v30u_ce -> $v30u_ce   (the CE multicycle) ---
  from  : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_eu:u_eu|opc_from_modrm
  to    : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_eu:u_eu|Mux79~0_OTERM2557
  k = 4.0000   slack =  +54.759   ->  T_min  17.560 ns  =    56.95 MHz

--- k=1.5  $v30u_ce -> t1_half2 ---
  from  : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_eu:u_eu|upc_opc[3]~DUPLICATE
  to    : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_biu:u_biu|t1_half2
  k = 1.5000   slack =  +29.765   ->  T_min  11.407 ns  =    87.67 MHz

--- k=2.5  t1_half2 -> $v30u_ce ---
  from  : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_biu:u_biu|t1_half2
  to    : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_biu:u_biu|r_cur_data[14]
  k = 2.5000   slack =  +68.275   ->  T_min   3.940 ns  =   253.81 MHz

--- k=0.5  (not $v30u_ce) -> t1_half2   -- the ENABLE arc ---
  from  : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|nec_bus:bus|div_cnt[2]
  to    : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_biu:u_biu|t1_half2
  k = 0.5000   slack =   +9.263   ->  T_min  12.724 ns  =    78.59 MHz

  observation endpoints (incl. core_ad_hold if RETENTION): 64

==========================================================================
 THE LADDER BEHIND THE BINDING CONE
==========================================================================

 ⚠ EVERY RUNG IS RESTRICTED TO divclk -> divclk.  Quartus's own Fmax
   Summary note says FMAX is computed ONLY for paths whose source and
   destination are driven by the SAME clock, so a cross-domain path
   (the JTAG hub, the HPS bridge) is not a divclk ceiling and must not
   be quoted as one.  A first run of this script without the filter
   returned the sld_jtag_hub at rung 2; that hit is EXCLUDED here for
   that reason, and this note is why.

--- RUNG 1: not latching in an observation register ---
  from  : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|nec_bus:bus|div_cnt[2]
  to    : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_biu:u_biu|t1_half2
  k = 0.5000   slack =   +9.263   ->  T_min  12.724 ns  =    78.59 MHz

--- RUNG 1a: ...and not t1_half2 either (the worst k=1 survivor) ---
  from  : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|c_int_q
  to    : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_eu:u_eu|row_posted
  k = 1.0000   slack =  +10.481   ->  T_min  20.769 ns  =    48.15 MHz

--- RUNG 2: ...and not launching from c_int_q ---
  from  : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|nec_bus:bus|div_cnt[2]
  to    : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_biu:u_biu|t1_half2
  k = 0.5000   slack =   +9.263   ->  T_min  12.724 ns  =    78.59 MHz

--- RUNG 3: ...and not latching in row_posted ---
  from  : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|nec_bus:bus|div_cnt[2]
  to    : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_biu:u_biu|t1_half2
  k = 0.5000   slack =   +9.263   ->  T_min  12.724 ns  =    78.59 MHz

==========================================================================
 TRUE CEILING over the five classes: T_min 26.505 ns = 37.73 MHz
   bound by: DEFAULT (whole-design worst, expect k=1)   (emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_eu:u_eu|upc_opc[3]~DUPLICATE -> emu:emu|system_large:system_large|nec_bus:bus|ad_in_q[8])
==========================================================================

 Compare against Quartus's OWN Fmax Summary in <rev>.sta.rpt, which is
 the authority.  Its note says it scales the rising and falling edges
 along with FMAX, so it handles the negedge destination itself.
